node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 exact distinct-slope budget ledger
node.statement: Conditional on the complete positive-coordinate payment, corrected active component/orientation assembly, and exact active-allocation inequality, the balanced-core K3 arm has the disjoint distinct-affine-slope ledger U_K3=U_positive+U_geometry within its active allocation. Here U_geometry includes the remaining source-line, biquadratic source-cover, and trivial-stabilizer payments; the proved saturated c2(1,1,2), c2(2,0,2), and negative-coordinate exclusions contribute zero. Every nonzero one-pencil payment has genuine-pencil hypotheses and exact relevant-line and bridge multiplicity; every higher-dimensional survivor has an exact ray compiler. No unnamed multiplicity, dropped balanced-core qualifier, owner change, or separately normalized budget is allowed.
node.falsifier: A missing or overlapping slope owner, incorrect route integer, non-genuine pencil payment, uncounted line, unpaid higher-dimensional survivor, or U_K3 above the active allocation.
